purpose: This form is used by a dormant company to apply for the status of an active company under section 455 of the Companies Act, 2013.
when: Within seven days from an event where a dormant company does or omits to do any act mentioned in the Grounds of application in Form MSC-1 affecting its status, or as otherwise required.
steps: Prepare Form MSC-4 for seeking the status of an active company.
Prepare a return in Form MSC-3 in respect of the financial year in which the application is being filed.
Submit Form MSC-4 along with the required fees and the Form MSC-3 return to the Registrar.
Wait for the Registrar to consider the application and issue a certificate in Form MSC-5.
checklist: Return in Form MSC-3 for the relevant financial year
Fees as provided in the Companies (Registration Offices and Fees) Rules, 2014
watch: The Registrar shall initiate the process of striking off the name of the company if the company remains as a dormant company for a period of consecutive five years.
